title: AION 2 Database: Items, Skills and Character Lookup
description: Use the official item and character links on this site to inspect equipment and players. For an external database, select the Steam release and match its item name, acquisition route and requirements with your client before spending materials. The character-level cap is 45. Follow your faction’s campaign and finish its remaining unlocks after reaching the cap. Character level, skill rank and gathering proficiency are separate progression systems.
summary: Look up items, skills, acquisition routes and player profiles using this site's official links and external databases.
